hyunhak-site/my.html.title: 스튜디오에서 영상과 첨삭 보기 uses window.open after await, which iOS Safari blocks as a popup
hyunhak-site/my.html.repro: On iPhone Safari, log in, open my.html, section 응시 기록, tap 스튜디오에서 영상과 첨삭 보기.
hyunhak-site/my.html.evidence: my.html:574-575: `.hgo` click handler does `var r=await HH.api('/api/studio/token',{... view:'history'}); window.open(r.url,'_blank','noopener');` — the open happens outside the user-gesture call stack. The repo's own fix note for the identical pattern: owned.js:79-80 '휴대폰(coarse pointer)은 같은 탭으로 간다: fetch 뒤의 window.open 은 iOS Safari 가 팝업으로 막고' and my.html:631 'fetch 뒤 window.open 은 iOS Safari 가 팝업으로 막았다'. The .sgo path was migrated to HH.studioGo (my.html:632) but .hgo was not.
hyunhak-site/my.html.fix_hint: Route .hgo through the same coarse-pointer branch as HH.studioGo (location.assign on phones, pre-opened window on desktop), passing {view:'history'}.
votes: confirm: Confirmed: /Users/gregory/Workspace/hyunhak-site/my.html:574-575 still does `await HH.api('/api/studio/token',{view:'history'})` then `window.open(r.url,'_blank','noopener')`, while the sibling .sgo handler at my.html:630 was migrated to HH.studioGo (assets/owned.js:76-91, which pre-opens the window in the gesture on desktop and uses location.assign on coarse-pointer devices) with the repo's own comment at my.html:629 and owned.js:74-75 stating the fetch-then-window.open pattern is blocked as a popup on iOS Safari; the API accepts view:'history' (hyunhak-api/src/trial.js:59) so the button is live, and since window.open returns null without throwing, the tap fails silently with no alert. Not reproducible on-device here (render harness is Chromium and never clicks .hgo), but the identical pattern is documented as broken by the repo itself; index.html:201 has the same unmigrated pattern.

confirm: Confirmed: my.html:574-575 `.hgo` handler runs `await HH.api('/api/studio/token',{view:'history'})` then `window.open(r.url,'_blank','noopener')` with no coarse-pointer branch or pre-opened window, while the fix for the identical pattern exists in assets/owned.js:76-91 (HH.studioGo: pre-open in gesture on desktop, location.assign on phones) and was applied only to `.sgo` (my.html:630) and studio.html:551.
